description:
Cheaper ways to make one trip on a given date, closest to what was asked first: the same route a few days
        earlier or later, a nearby airport (for example Islamabad or Sialkot instead of Lahore, with road time), or two
        separate tickets changing planes in Pakistan or Saudi Arabia (never a self-transfer needing a transit visa).
        Use for "cheapest way to get from Dammam to Lahore on 14 November" or "is there a cheaper option than my flight".
        origin and destination: a city name or 3-letter airport code. date: YYYY-MM-DD. Prices are in PKR, one-way.
name: cheaper_options
title: Cheaper ways to make a trip
